notes.title: Hard mode saving fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where quitting to main menu and then to desktop would override the save.

notes.title: Saving fixed
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the game wouldn’t load the save after exiting the game. Saving now works correctly on exit.

notes.title: Checkpoints fixed
notes.notes: Quitting the game will no longer reset the checkpoints.

notes.title: Ladder, Mantle bar, Level design improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Level design improved flow, tweaked difficulty, made less inconsistent mostly for final level
[*] Ladder - slower speed and bigger collision
[*] Mantle Bar - slower speed
[*] Posters censored 
[*] Added longer time for saving before quitting to desktop
[/list]

notes.title: Ladder collision fix
notes.notes: Fix for ladder collision box which was smaller on shorter ladders than the longer ones.
